description: This bar chart illustrates the popularity scores for different large language models (LLMs) across three knowledge domains. The horizontal axis represents the knowledge domain categories: “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Popularity”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, with tick marks at intervals of 20.  There are six sets of bars for each knowledge domain, each representing a different LLM: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (orange), ChatGPT (red), Acc=0 & GT Ans (light blue, patterned), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (dark orange, patterned), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (yellow). For the “Movies” category, the bar heights are approximately 24 for Llama3, 30 for Qwen2, 32 for ChatGPT, 28 for Acc=0 & GT Ans, 26 for Acc=0 & Gene Ans, and 22 for Acc=1 & GT Ans. In the “Songs” category, the bar heights are approximately 56 for Llama3, 68 for Qwen2, 72 for ChatGPT, 62 for Acc=0 & GT Ans, 58 for Acc=0 & Gene Ans, and 48 for Acc=1 & GT Ans. For “Basketball”, the bar heights are approximately 104 for Llama3, 116 for Qwen2, 184 for ChatGPT, 108 for Acc=0 & GT Ans, 96 for Acc=0 & Gene Ans, and 152 for Acc=1 & GT Ans. The bars are grouped by knowledge domain, with each LLM represented by a distinct color within each group. No bars are visually emphasized, and the categories are not sorted in any apparent order.
